FsmLivenessView.description: One register's liveness inventory (`check-fsm --liveness`): out of reset, resets pinned inactive.

absorbing.description: Reachable encodings the register can never leave, not declared intended.

reset_value.description: The register's value out of reset, when the reset logic gives one.

returns_to_reset.description: `AG EF (reg == reset_value)`: `holds | violated | unknown | skipped` (no reset value).

unreachable.description: Legal encodings no path from reset reaches.

FsmRegisterFinding.description: One state register's illegal-encoding result in a [`Btor2CheckFsmResponse`].

illegal_encoding_reachable.description: `true` when an illegal encoding is reachable (a finding).

kind.description: `"fsm"` — an enumeration-valued register, checked; `"counter"` — a register its own next-state logic steps by ±1, set aside with no legal set and no verdict (its values are a range, not an enumeration; #633).

legal_encodings.description: The legal encodings the register's own logic recognizes (sorted); empty for a `"counter"`.

outcome.description: Canonical verdict — `"holds"` (stays within its encoding) | `"violated"` (an illegal encoding is reachable) | `"unknown"` (the portfolio could not decide) | `"skipped"` (a `"counter"`, not checked).

register.description: The state register's symbol — the cell's own, or a value-identical alias of it (`state_q`, the port that mirrors it); never a next-value wire (#633).

fsm_registers_checked.description: Number of `"fsm"`-kind registers scanned (a `"counter"` entry in `registers` is listed, not counted).

illegal_encodings_found.description: Number of registers with a reachable illegal encoding (`verdict == "violated"`).

liveness.description: The liveness inventory, when `liveness` was requested.
